extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings, next hearing listed at Central Family Court
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Danvers Partners enquires about a £30,500 litigation loan for his client, the wife in divorce financial remedy proceedings, where around £470,500 of property and pension assets are in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client regarding funding for her financial remedy proceedings. So that we can consider it, we would be grateful for confirmation of your client's details, a breakdown of the costs for which funding is sought (including counsel and expert fees), and details of the assets in dispute with any supporting valuations or Form E material available. It would also help to have confirmation of the current procedural position and the date of the next listed hearing. We will send our criteria and application form, and a colleague will review the information once received. Nothing in this message implies any offer or decision on funding.
